title: Measure of the Amount Asked on a Waiver Request, Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery
content:
**Clause.** The amount a waiver request asks VA to waive on a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery** is the debt's outstanding balance less the amount the debtor is expected to repay from their own means. The expected repayment is a monthly repayment capacity equal to the smallest plan installment of the debt type, carried over a repayment horizon equal to the longest plan approved without a Financial Status Report, with every month of the horizon counted. The request never asks for less than zero and is rounded to the cent.

## Condition — judgement — result

| Element | Definition |
|---|---|
| Outstanding balance | The balance on the debt record now |
| Monthly repayment capacity | The smallest plan installment of the debt type |
| Repayment horizon | The longest plan approved without a Financial Status Report for the debt type, every month counted |
| Expected repayment | The monthly capacity multiplied by the horizon months counted |
| Amount asked | The outstanding balance less the expected repayment; never below zero; rounded to the cent only at the end |

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs)

**A.** A Veterans Pension Overpayment with 1,800.00 USD outstanding, a smallest plan installment of 25.00 USD and a 12-month horizon: expected repayment 25.00 multiplied by 12, that is 300.00 USD; amount asked 1,800.00 less 300.00, that is 1,500.00 USD.

**B.** A Home Loan Guaranty Debt with 450.00 USD outstanding, a smallest plan installment of 50.00 USD and a 12-month horizon: expected repayment 600.00 USD exceeds the balance, and the amount asked is zero, never a negative figure.

The installment and horizon figures above are hypothetical inputs to the method; the figures that apply are those of the debt type in the schedule of repayment terms.
